Nepal Flash Floods: Rescue Efforts Continue Amidst Missing Persons and Aid Delivery

Following devastating flash floods and landslides in Nepal, rescue operations are ongoing for approximately 3,000 individuals still missing. International aid is arriving, with the UAE sending 83 tonnes of relief supplies. A former NDMA advisor has urged for an accelerated mitigation program. Meanwhile, reports indicate that China is censoring images and information related to the disaster in Tibet, with Tibetan campaigners claiming the scale of destruction and missing persons is higher than officially acknowledged by Beijing. The floods are also testing the capacity of Nepal's young government.
